title: Building a Harbour from Memory
paras: At a coastal community museum, a model of the old harbour begins with conversations rather than drawings. Its purpose is the [[preservation|preservation]] of memories that photographs alone cannot capture. Former boatbuilders bring sketches, while retired sailors describe how they used to [[steer|steer]] fishing boats through the narrow entrance. Their accounts determine the position of walls and landing places.

Next, model makers compare these memories with maps and records of [[commercial|commercial]] shipping. Details often awaken visitors’ [[curiosity|curiosity]]: why, for example, did a warehouse display a portrait of an [[emperor|emperor]]? An old photograph confirms that it did, although nobody knows why. Where evidence is missing, the team leaves a space rather than inventing a convincing detail.

The harbour takes shape on a wooden base. Thin [[steel|steel]] rods support the taller buildings, and painted card becomes stone. Volunteer Amira works beside her [[sibling|sibling]], carefully cutting tiny windows. This delicate work initially feels [[alien|alien]] to her after years of repairing engines, but her practical skills prove useful. Each roof can be lifted off so that damaged parts can be replaced.

Finally, the team adds labels explaining the harbour’s closure after a severe storm. One records a dockworker who was a [[casualty|casualty]] of the disaster; another explains why families had to [[abandon|abandon]] their waterfront homes permanently. At the opening, residents recognise familiar doorways. The finished model preserves not simply a place, but the lives once built around it.
zh: 在一座沿海社区博物馆里，旧港湾模型的制作不是从绘图开始，而是从交谈开始。它的目的是保存那些仅凭照片无法完整留住的记忆。以前的造船工人带来了草图，退休水手则描述过去如何驾驶渔船穿过狭窄的入口。他们的讲述帮助确定了墙体和靠岸点的位置。
接下来，模型制作者将这些记忆与地图及商业航运记录相互核对。一些细节常常激起参观者的好奇心：比如，一座仓库为什么会挂着皇帝的画像？一张老照片证实画像确实存在，但没人知道原因。对于缺少证据的地方，团队宁可留白，也不编造看似可信的细节。
港湾在木制底板上逐渐成形。细钢杆支撑着较高的建筑，上色的卡纸则用来模拟石材。志愿者阿米拉和自己的手足并肩工作，小心翼翼地裁出一扇扇小窗。多年来一直修理发动机的她，起初对这种精细活儿感到陌生，但她的动手技能后来派上了用场。每个屋顶都可以取下，以便更换损坏的部件。
最后，团队添加了说明标签，介绍港湾在一场强烈风暴之后关闭的经过。其中一块记录了一名在灾难中伤亡的码头工人；另一块解释了为什么一些家庭不得不永久离开水边的家园。展览开幕时，居民们认出了熟悉的门口。完成的模型不仅保存了一个地方，也保存了曾围绕它展开的生活。

q.s: Work on the harbour model begins with drawings rather than conversations.
q.why: 首段明确说制作从交谈而非绘图开始。

q.s: An old photograph confirms that the warehouse displayed an emperor's portrait.
q.why: 老照片证实仓库确实挂过皇帝画像。

q.s: Amira took a model-making course before joining the project.
q.why: 文章未说明阿米拉是否学过模型制作。
